### Nested Schema for `items.spec`

Optional:

- `auth_secret_ref` (String) AuthSecretRef is the name of a secret containing 'username' and 'password' keys to authenticate to vSphere.
- `external_id` (String) ExternalID is the external ID of the plugin.
- `heartbeat_interval` (Number) HeartbeatInterval is the time interval in seconds between successive heartbeats.
- `name` (String) Name is the name of the plugin.
- `nsx_certificate` (String) NSXCertificate is the certificate for the server to verify.
- `nsx_management_ip` (String) NSXManagementIP is the URL to the NSX manager.
- `nsx_poll_interval` (Number) NSXPollInterval determines how often the plugin polls NSX for state changes. Unit is seconds.
- `nsx_tls_verify` (Boolean) NSXTLSVerify defines whether the client verifies the server's certificate.
- `plugin_namespace` (String) PluginNamespace is the namespace for the custom resources.
- `v_centers` (Attributes List) VCenters is the list of vCenters managed by the NSX plugin. All vCenters managed by the
NSX plugin need to be managed by a VMware plugin. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--spec--v_centers))
